title: fix(lint)!: the object save door gives the build's object action predicate verdict (#22032 pass 4)
body:
Part of #22032
Clause-②: no (narrowing: the object save door refuses an action visible or disabled predicate os build already refuses)

This is pass 4 of #22032, the last of the four passes in triage's order: the object's own action predicates, `actions[].visible` and `actions[].disabled`. After it, every expression an object carries gets the build's verdict at the object save door. The card stays open until the seat records this landing.

## What changes

**The object save door gives the build's verdict on an object action's `visible` and `disabled`.** `formulas.mdx` says "the same `validateExpression` validator backs `os build` and metadata registration". After pass 3 the object door ran every other pass over the object's body and kept the object action loop fenced. So an object whose action carried `visible: 'amount > 1'` (a bare field reference) still saved with a 200, while `os build` refused it at error. The action runtime evaluates such a predicate fail-closed, so the action was hidden on every record.

- **The lift is one guard (H1 measured).** On `origin/main` `7d7943dd0d` the loop read `for (const obj of objectWrite ? [] : objects)` (`validate-expressions.ts:2251`). It now reads `for (const obj of objects)`. That one guard covers both keys: `checkAction` judges `visible`, and `disabled` unless it is a boolean literal. The loops over the stack's other collections keep their guards: flows, the top-level `actions`, sharing rules and hooks. They are not the object's own body, the object write's snapshot does not carry them, and each is judged at its own type's door.
- **One location differs from the build, never the verdict.** An action that is also declared in the stack's top-level `actions` is located by `os build` at `stack · action 'NAME' visible`, because `checkAction` de-duplicates the merged copy. The door judges the object alone and locates the same predicate at `object 'OBJ' · action 'NAME' visible`. This is pinned, and the PARITY pins use object-only bodies.
- **Docblocks made true.** `StackExpressionOptions.runtimeWriteType` now names five admitted passes and says which loops stay off an object write. `AuthoringRuleContext.runtimeWriteType` in `authoring-rules.ts`, the one line that reaches a built `.d.ts`, names the object-action pass. The registry entry gains a `[#22032, pass 4]` measurement comment, as passes 1 to 3 added theirs, and its narrowing paragraph no longer speaks of a fenced object-borne pass. Comments in four sibling lint tests and in four blocks of the protocol test are corrected so that none of them still calls the action predicates fenced.
- **Rider 1.** The option-loop comment now names the showcase's role gate as written, `'org_admin' in current_user.positions`.
- **No code change in `packages/metadata-protocol`.** Only its test file gains the door-level pins.

## The platform's own `sys_approval_request` (ruled F1 in `6054240056`)

The stored corpus has one object the validator refuses: `sys_approval_request` (`@objectstack/plugin-approvals`). Its 8 action `visible` predicates read `record.viewer`, a block the approvals service attaches on read and the object does not declare (``unknown field `viewer` on `sys_approval_request` ``). #22211 carries the producer. Until it lands, a save of that packaged object answers as follows. The first two rows were measured on the showcase's `objectstack dev` boot at this head, `6e141edcad`; the "before" values were measured at `5d1d1aca6d`. The third row is a source reading.

| kernel and setting | publish save, before → after | draft save |
|:--|:--|:--|
| host-config kernel, no `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` → 422 `INVALID_METADATA` (8 issues) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` |
| `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=object` | 200 → 422 `INVALID_METADATA` (8 issues) | 200 |
| environment-scoped kernel | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, unchanged | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` |

On a host-config kernel, `saveMetaItem` runs the authoring gate (`protocol.ts:20735` at this head) before the package door. On that topology the package door answers only at the repository write: `repo.put` at `:21048`, which calls `assertAllowed` at `sys-metadata-repository.ts:730`. On an environment-scoped kernel, `refusePackagedBaseOverride` (`:20257`, under `this.environmentId !== undefined`) answers 403 before the gate. #22220 carries that order. The changeset states the table as a measured fact. The object itself is unchanged: it registers, is served, and its actions evaluate as before (P2 below).

## Pins

- **Lint door:** `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-action-predicate-writes.test.ts` (new, 19 tests).
  - LIT: one refused body per finding kind, on both keys. For `visible`: a bare `amount > 1`, an unregistered `sqrt(record.amount) > 1`, an unknown field `record.amont > 1` and a syntax error `record.status ==`. For `disabled`: a bare `amount > 1` and the syntax error. Each is located at the action and asserted on its named subject.
  - CONTROL (still accepted, at both doors): the shapes the platform and the examples ship. These are a `record` comparison, the `{ dialect, source }` envelope, `'org_admin' in current_user.positions`, `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true`, `features.organization != false`, a `false` literal, a `disabled` predicate, and a `true` `disabled` the build never judges.
  - PARITY: for each refused object body, the door's findings equal the build's.
  - LOCATION: an action also declared top-level is located by the build at `stack · action`, and by the door at the object. Message and severity are equal.
  - Stored universe (#22118's baseline). A clean write beside a stored sibling whose actions the build refuses passes. Over a broken stored self, a clean save passes and re-saving the broken body is refused, because re-saving a row is writing it.
- **The enumeration pin** in `runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts` takes its new shape (H2). One body carries a fault in every pass over the object's body: the validation rule, `requiredWhen`, an option's `visibleWhen`, and an action's `visible` and `disabled`. The build and the object door flag the same 5 sites in the same order, so a fence re-added on any object-borne pass drops its site and turns it red. A second half carries a fault in each other collection: a top-level action, a flow edge, a sharing rule and a hook. The build flags all 9 sites in its walk order. `runStackExpressionPasses` on an object write returns exactly the build's findings for the 5 object-borne sites, and a flow write still returns everything.
- **Protocol door:** a new pass-4 block at the end of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` (11 tests), through the real `saveMetaItem`, `publishMetaItem` and `publishPackageDrafts`.
  - (a) A bare reference and an unregistered function in `visible`, and a bare reference in `disabled`, are refused on an active save. Each answer is asserted on `{ code: 'INVALID_METADATA', status: 422 }` and carries the build's located finding, and nothing lands.
  - (a) The card-shaped body is refused on a draft's promotion and on a package draft publish (`outcome: 'refused'`, `failed` naming the object, the row left a draft). The draft saves themselves still succeed.
  - (b) Four shipped action shapes still save, and the row lands active.
  - (c) A stored sibling whose actions the build refuses does not block a clean save (H3).
  - (d) For each refused body, the door and `os build` give the same finding on rule, where, path, message and hint.

## Reverse verification (one-off, from committed HEAD `7ab81c8cf7`)

- **What was mutated.** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` put the guard back on the object action loop. The two-line anchor, the comment line plus `for (const obj of objects) {`, hit once, 1 to 0. It became `const ablationFence22032p4 = objectWrite;` followed by `for (const obj of ablationFence22032p4 ? [] : objects) {`, and the blob went `49b139316b0f` to `d42d50a1acbf`. The outer script held `trap restore EXIT INT TERM` on the absolute path.
- **Rebuild and dist proof.** `@objectstack/lint` was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files.
- **Lint pins (source): 11 failed and 17 passed, as predicted before the run.**
  - Red: the 6 LIT tests, PARITY, LOCATION, the stored-self test, and the two enumeration-pin tests that read the door.
  - Green: the registry test, the 8 CONTROL tests, the differential, the build-flags test and the 6 formula-door tests.
- **Protocol file (dist-mediated): 6 failed and 108 passed, as predicted.** Red: the three (a) saves, (a) on promotion, (a) on package publish, and (d). Green: the four (b) saves, (c), and every other block.
- **Restore.** The blob is `49b139316b0f`, equal to HEAD; `git diff HEAD` is 0 lines; the whole tree has 0 changed paths. Lint was rebuilt, and `--absent` found the marker gone from all 14 built files. Both suites went green again: lint 28 of 28, and the protocol file 114 of 114.

## Measurements (the ruling's premises)

- **P1, corpus first (stop condition not met beyond the ruled case).** The same harness ran on `7d7943dd0d` without the lift and with an uncommitted lift, and again on the committed head `7ab81c8cf7`. No corpus file moved up to the merged head `6e141edcad`.
  - Corpus A (passes 1 to 3's): every `*.object.ts` under `packages/**` and `examples/**` (111 files) plus the two `app-multi-package` sub-stacks. That is 118 objects in 18 groups, 16 of them carrying 73 actions with 58 `visible` predicates.
  - Corpus B, added for this pass: the example stacks as `defineStack` composes them, with standalone actions merged in. That is 33 objects in 5 groups, 5 of them carrying 79 actions with 57 `visible` and 2 `disabled` predicates.
  - Each object was judged at the raw shape and at the `ObjectSchema.parse` shape (0 parse failures), with its own group as context, so every save is an update and runs the stored pass.
  - The door gives 0 action findings without the lift. With it, the door refuses exactly the 8 `sys_approval_request` sites in A, at both shapes, with 0 advisories, and 0 in B. No new site, and the site lists are identical across all three runs.
  - Non-vacuity: breaking every A and B site in a copy (117) gives build 117, and door 0 without the lift, 117 with it.
  - Positive control (one action with `visible: 'amount > 1'` and `disabled: 'sqrt(record.amount) > 1'`): build 2, and door 0 without the lift, 2 with it.
- **P2 holds.** The runtime authoring gate is reached only from `saveMetaItem` and `publishMetaItem` (`assertRuntimeAuthoringRules`). A code plugin registers its objects through the manifest service and never reaches it. With the lift built: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-override-composite-pin.dogfood.test.ts` passed 1 of 1, booting the real stack with `ApprovalsServicePlugin` and serving `sys_approval_request` with its 8 actions. `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` passed 61 files and 899 tests, and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 221 files and 28260 tests.
- **P3 was falsified in round 2 and ruled F1.** The table above replaces it.

## Clause-② (measured)

- **Accept set: narrowing.** An object write in publish mode answered 200 for an action `visible` or `disabled` the validator refuses. It now answers 422 on the active save, a draft's promotion and a package draft publish, each measured through the real methods above. A draft save stays ungated.
- **Built entry declarations.** In `@objectstack/lint` one doc comment moves (`AuthoringRuleContext.runtimeWriteType`). No exported signature moves.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/22032-object-save-door-action-predicates.md` covers `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` as `minor`, as passes 1 to 3 did. It carries `fix(lint)!`, the Clause-② line above, a BREAKING section with the remedy and the per-kernel table, and ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `.changeset/pre.json` is absent on `origin/main`.

## Rider 2: the pending object-door changesets made consistent (ruled Q2-A in `6053857898`)

`check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` is red on purpose, and it stays red. This PR changes four changesets it did not add: `22019-object-save-door-formula-verdict.md`, `22032-object-save-door-validation-predicates.md`, `22032-object-save-door-field-rule-slots.md` and `22032-object-save-door-option-visible-when.md`. That is the gate's "deliberate correction" class, not a collision. Each pending entry had a line saying the door still does not judge passes that a landed pass, or this one, now judges. Compiled together, those lines would contradict each other.

- In each of the four, only that "Unchanged" line is rewritten, so that it names the expressions this entry's crossing covers and points the rest at their own #22032 entries. The `conditionalRequired` slot is no longer listed as joining the door, because pass 2's entry says it is refused at the schema step.
- Pass 3's sentence "This supersedes the earlier #22032 entries' line that option `visibleWhen` is not judged at this door." is deleted. It pointed at the lines above.
- Nothing else in those files moves. The seat's ruling `6053857898` (Q2) is the confirmation the gate asks for. ⛔ No `skip-changeset`.

## Merges

- **`6e141edcad`** merges `origin/main` `3b493184e1` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. It brought PR #22196, PR #22205 and PR #22185 (the `/meta` draft head resolution in `protocol.ts` and `sys-metadata-repository.ts`). The merge was clean, and no generated path was taken from either side. After the merge: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, a full turbo build (72 tasks), and `@objectstack/spec check:generated` ("All 15 generated artifacts are up to date").
- PR #22185 moved the save path's line numbers, not its order. The table's "after" values were measured again at `6e141edcad`.

## Tests and gates (at `6e141edcad` unless a reading names another head)

- **`@objectstack/lint`** at `7ab81c8cf7`: 126 files and 5748 tests passed. `typecheck` exit 0, with its test-typecheck at 2 files and 6 errors held in the debt ledger, unchanged. `--listFilesOnly` puts the new test file in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program. At `6e141edcad` the seven `runtime-gate.object-*` and stored-self files passed, 116 of 116.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`** at `7ab81c8cf7`: 221 files passed and 3 skipped; 28271 tests passed and 19 skipped. At `6e141edcad` the door file passed 114 of 114, and `typecheck` exit 0.
- **Consumer readings** at `7ab81c8cf7`, against a full build:
  - `@objectstack/rest`: every `meta-object-*` file, `meta-publish-package-scope` and `rest.test.ts`, 12 files and 412 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/objectql`: `publish-package-drafts-response-conformance`, `save-meta-response-conformance`, `publish-meta-response-conformance`, `plugin.integration` and `engine`, 5 files and 218 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: `meta-field-overlay-lock`, 16 tests passed.
- **Gates.** `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 commands. Each exit code was captured before any pipe: 62 exited 0, and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exited 1 (rider 2, above). `--ran` reconciles 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, with an exit code recorded for each.
- **ESLint, narrowed to the 9 touched TypeScript files** (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 9 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. Each file is matched by `eslint.config.mjs` (`--print-config`). The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **The window the ruling names.** Until this lands, the pending pass 1 to 3 changesets still carry the stale lines. If Version Packages compiles first, they publish.
- **#22157** (an option `visibleWhen` that reads `parent`) is not touched here.
- **Contract review.** Triage's grade asks for one per pass. It is the seat's, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
